label: Hexagon French Cuff — 4 Buttonholes
description: The hexagon French cuff is a double cuff whose folded edge is cut with an angled, mitered corner so the silhouette reads as a faceted hexagonal shape rather than a plain square. Worn with cufflinks like any French cuff, the angled cut adds a distinctive, sartorial geometry that catches the eye at the wrist. It keeps full formal status while giving the cuff a more bespoke, characterful outline.
